asr.full_text: Hi friends! Do you want to keep your searches local on your Windows 8.1 PC? You need to disable the Bing integration. Let's see how you can enable or disable Bing to search online in your Windows 8.1 PC. To display the Bing integration go to the CHARMS search menu. Select Settings, and then type search in the search box. Click on Search settings from the displayed results. Here you can see that the option Use Bing to Search Online is on. To turn this feature off click on the slider button. You can also click on the Clear button to clear your search history. Click on Clear again to confirm. See, that wasn't hard at all. Thanks for watching! Thank you.
